$comment: What the compatibility matrix (Strategy §145, plan step N4.5) says beyond the suite's areas: each capability's status on WitOS, the step or milestone that gives it, and the fact behind the status. compatibility-matrix renders this with the suite's checks and expectations.json into @Docs/Implementation/Compatibility-Matrix.md; a host test requires the document to be current. A status is Supported, Partial, Absent or Planned.

capabilities.name: CoreCLR with the JIT, `Reflection.Emit`, `AssemblyLoadContext`
capabilities.note: Every method is compiled into the double mapping of a shared memory file; upstream's PAL suite and slices of its runtime and library tests pass in the guest.

capabilities.name: Shared framework through `dotnet App.dll`
capabilities.note: The install under `/dotnet` as the shared-framework packaging lays it out; an application the stock SDK publishes without a RID runs unchanged.

capabilities.name: .NET 8 and .NET 10 side by side
capabilities.note: `release/8.0` with its own patch set beside `release/10.0`; `rollForward` and `--roll-forward` select the framework.

capabilities.name: NativeAOT
capabilities.note: The system's own tool for the services of the boot package, not the application contract.

capabilities.name: Garbage collector
capabilities.note: The workstation GC with its heap bounded to 75% of what a process may own (`DOTNET_GCTotalPhysicalMemory`); the server GC waits for phase P, since one processor schedules threads.

capabilities.name: Globalization with ICU
capabilities.note: ICU4C 78.3 built from the pinned source; invariant mode only where an application asks for it.

capabilities.name: Time zones
capabilities.note: `TimeZoneInfo` from pinned tzdata under `/usr/share/zoneinfo`; `/etc/localtime` is UTC.

capabilities.name: Files and directories on volumes
capabilities.note: ext4 (written through the journal), FAT and `/tmp` through the namespace service; modes and times as the volume keeps them; the boot package read-only.

capabilities.name: Memory-mapped files
capabilities.note: A private mapping is a copy, a shared one shows the service's pages; `MemoryMappedFile` works, the copy's cost is the file's size.

capabilities.name: File change notifications (`FileSystemWatcher`)
capabilities.note: `PlatformNotSupportedException`: the namespace service sends none.

capabilities.name: Processes (`Process.Start`, `WaitForExit`, redirected streams, `Kill`)
capabilities.note: `posix_spawn` over the process manager with pipes between processes; no process enumeration, no other process's name or times, no signal but `SIGKILL`, one user, no process groups.

capabilities.name: Console and terminal
capabilities.note: The terminal service over the virtio console with Linux's line discipline: `ReadLine`, `ReadKey`, `KeyAvailable`, `CancelKeyPress`, the window size; without a terminal the standard streams are the kernel log.

capabilities.name: PowerShell 7 (upstream, `dotnet pwsh.dll`, PSReadLine)
capabilities.note: RFC 0020 §56 T2: the shell on the serial terminal of N4.3, its native library built for the witos triples, terminfo from a pinned ncurses.

capabilities.name: Text console on a display (framebuffer, keyboard)
capabilities.note: The firmware's framebuffer published as a device region, a virtio keyboard, a NativeAOT display service behind the terminal service; the serial console stays.

capabilities.name: Named synchronization objects (`Mutex` with a name)
capabilities.note: Under `/tmp/.dotnet` in the namespace service's `/tmp`.

capabilities.name: Cryptography
capabilities.note: System.Native's random bytes, the managed hashes, HMAC and the KDFs, as in the browser flavor; `PlatformNotSupportedException` for the rest; no OpenSSL.

capabilities.name: Networking (`Socket`, `HttpClient`)
capabilities.note: Absent: `System.Net.Sockets` and `System.Net.Security.Native` fail explicitly until the network service of M7.

capabilities.name: ASP.NET Core
capabilities.note: Needs networking.

capabilities.name: Diagnostics (`createdump`, EventPipe, `dotnet-dump`)
capabilities.note: Decided with the debugger story.

capabilities.name: Compression (`System.IO.Compression`)
capabilities.note: zlib-ng and brotli in-tree.

capabilities.name: Server GC and several scheduling processors
capabilities.note: The kernel starts every processor at boot and schedules threads on one.

capabilities.name: Avalonia and other GUI frameworks
capabilities.note: Needs the presentation layer of RFC 0009.

hardware.note: Every gate runs on it; a step closes only when both ISAs pass.

Phase V, begun with the measurement V0 (2026-10-16): the pinned QEMU carries qemu-system-riscv64 and EDK II's RISC-V firmware; the pinned lld-link links no RISC-V PE/COFF, so the loader's image format is V0's first decision.
After phase V; firmware memory reclamation and the hardware matrix of Strategy §146.
